title: Atlassian security advisory (AV26-1166)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1166 Date: November 17, 2026 As of November 17, 2026, Atlassian is affected by a vulnerability in the following products: Jira Service Management Data Center Version 10.3.27 and prior Version 11.3.13 and prior Jira Service Management Server Versions 5.12.16 to 5.12.42 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Improper Authorization in Jira Service Management Data Center Security Advisories | Atlassian Article Link: Atlassian security advisory (AV26-1166) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
